section_text_with_unit_anchors:
[v7u_N004958|4958] AFC compliance technology solutions rely on data governance processes to ensure high-quality data.
ZH: 金融犯罪防控合规技术解决方案依赖数据治理流程确保数据质量

[v7u_N004959|4959] A well-structured data governance framework includes ongoing processes for both approval and oversight.
ZH: 良好的数据治理框架包括持续的审批和监督流程

[v7u_N004960|4960] Data is rarely permanent and will require changes such as additions, deletions, merging, separation, and other transformation activities needed for compliance system operations.
ZH: 数据需要增删、合并、分离等变更以满足合规系统运行需求

[v7u_N004961|4961] Most common changes involve introducing new data sources or modifying existing ones, such as integrating third-party watchlists, sanctions lists, or internal risk databases.
ZH: 常见数据变更包括集成第三方观察名单、制裁名单或内部风险数据库

[v7u_N004962|4962] These require a formal change management approval process, which should include impact assessments, validation checks, data mapping, and governance committee approvals before deployment.
ZH: 数据变更需经过正式的变更管理审批流程，包括影响评估、验证、数据映射和治理委员会批准

[v7u_N004963|4963] Changes can also encompass adjustments needed for active operating data used in compliance system models. Governance structures should approve changes to thresholds, rules, or machine learning parameters before implementation.
ZH: 合规系统模型中的阈值、规则或机器学习参数变更需经治理结构批准

[v7u_N004964|4964] Not all governance processes involve change.
ZH: 并非所有治理流程都涉及变更

[v7u_N004965|4965] Oversight processes include periodic data quality assessments and scheduled reviews of key data attributes, such as accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency.
ZH: 监督流程包括定期数据质量评估和关键数据属性审查

[v7u_N004966|4966] Governance teams conduct exception reporting, outlier analysis, and data reconciliation exercises to detect anomalies, and assign corrective action for deficiencies under supervision of the committee or delegate.
ZH: 治理团队通过异常报告、离群值分析和数据对账发现异常并分配纠正措施

[v7u_N004967|4967] These corrective actions are often associated with data or system changes that require additional governance approvals.
ZH: 纠正措施通常需要额外的治理审批

[v7u_N004968|4968] It is best practice to include a structured approval process before submitting AFC compliance system outputs to other stakeholders, such as audit teams and regulators.
ZH: 最佳实践要求在向审计团队和监管机构提交金融犯罪防控合规系统输出前进行结构化审批

[v7u_N004969|4969] These outputs include suspicious activity reports, transaction monitoring outputs, data quality reports, and outcomes from oversight processes.
ZH: 金融犯罪防控合规系统输出包括可疑活动报告、交易监控输出、数据质量报告和监督结果

[v7u_N004970|4970] Governance committees must review these key reports for precision.
ZH: 治理委员会必须审查关键报告的精确性

[v7u_N004971|4971] Role-based access control refers to a model of authorizing end-user access to specific systems and data based on the role of the end user.
ZH: 基于角色的访问控制根据最终用户角色授权其对特定系统和数据的访问

[v7u_N004972|4972] Data governance principles drive organizations to provide users access to data only when needed, with clear policies and procedures in place to govern the update of access rights.
ZH: 数据治理原则要求仅在需要时提供数据访问，并制定明确的政策和程序管理访问权限更新

[v7u_N004973|4973] Strong governance mechanisms generate trust in data-driven compliance solutions, ensuring they remain effective in combating financial crime while meeting evolving regulatory expectations.
ZH: 强有力的治理机制增强对数据驱动合规解决方案的信任，确保其有效打击金融犯罪并满足监管期望
